verdict.rationale: Authy is a 2FA authenticator app, so browser-extension autofill of TOTP codes and passkeys is a fair question for this kind of product. The evidence only covers mobile and desktop apps, multi-device sync, and backup. The Chrome extension appears only in community reports, which describe it as deprecated and used for hacky key extraction, never for autofilling codes or passkeys during login.

support.subject: As an everyday user, a browser extension autofills my TOTP codes and passkeys during login instead of making me retype them
